v84: FAILS - "for await..of loops are currently unsupported" (hermesc parse-time
     rejection of the for-await-of statement itself, independent of async
     generators).
v94: FAILS - same "for await..of loops are currently unsupported" error as v84.
v96: FAILS - reports BOTH errors together, a genuinely different diagnostic
     from v84/v94: "async generators are unsupported" on the
     `async function*` declaration itself, AND "for await..of loops are
     currently unsupported" on the for-await-of statement. So somewhere
     between v94 and v96 (react-native@0.72.17 -> react-native@0.73.11,
     classic-Hermes `main` lineage, still pre-static_h) hermesc grew an
     earlier, more specific rejection of `async function*` in addition to
     the pre-existing for-await-of rejection, rather than only tripping the
     later one first.
v98: FAILS - "async generators are unsupported" (same later-stage restriction
     as v99 - v98's hermesc also accepts for-await-of syntactically but
     rejects `async function*` declarations outright; both v98 and v99 are
     the static_h/Static Hermes lineage per docs/HBC-FORMAT.md sec 0).
v99: FAILS - "async generators are unsupported" (a different, later-stage
     restriction: v99's hermesc accepts for-await-of syntactically but rejects
     `async function*` declarations outright).

No hermesc version fetched by tools/get-hermesc.sh (84/94/96/98/99) can compile
this fixture. It is kept anyway (per docs/TEST-CORPUS.md #1a construct 30) as a
forward-looking Tier 1 fixture: it runs correctly under plain Node
(see expected.txt) and is valid input for the D2 trace-equivalence harness
once real bytecode support exists in some future Hermes/hermesc version, or
once this project's own emitter needs to represent the construct in reverse
(decompiling bytecode that predates async generators is out of scope, but the
construct fixture documents the gap either way).

No vNN.hbc files exist in this directory; tests/fixtures/build.sh skips this
fixture for all five compilers, matching this file.
